heroMockup: White-label handoff: one client-facing product window that starts as a Sandbox build (dashed outline, staging URL) and, as a hatched 'your brand applied' band sweeps across it, takes the agency's placeholder logo, accent and domain; framed by the agency's own inbox at the start and a 'who does what' ownership board (from the PartnersFlow widget) at the end. No other unit uses the brand-swap or the ownership board.
sourceOfClaims: src/i18n/units/partners.ts (hero, pains, offers, method, faq, cta), src/components/unit/PartnersFlow/copy.ts (stages, owners, 'Your client sees'), src/components/unit/visuals/copy.ts (partners handoff labels: builds & runs, your brand applied, sells & owns the client, sees one brand; packets agent, brain, report), and the blog post src/content/blog/en/white-label-ai-for-agencies.md (the client question 'So what are we doing with AI?', assistant with a site launch, AI search visibility). Timelines used exactly as written: Qualify 1-2 calls, Package 1-2 weeks, Deliver per project, Grow ongoing; White-label 3-10 weeks per project, Co-delivery per project, Referral ongoing. The agency is always the literal placeholder 'Your Agency' / 'Tu Agencia' and its domain 'youragency.com' / 'tuagencia.com'; client senders are initials only. Inbox times and section numbers are illustrative UI states. No prices, no rates, no partner percentages.
